Frequently asked questions

How do you split rent fairly between roommates?

Equal splits work when rooms are similar. When rooms differ in size or people earn differently, splitting by room size or income is usually seen as fairer.

How do I split rent by room size?

Enter each room’s square footage. Each person pays a share of the rent equal to their room’s share of the total area.

Should utilities be split the same way as rent?

Often not. Utilities are usually split equally because everyone uses them. Use the split bill calculator for those, and this tool for rent.

How do I split cost by income?

Choose “By income” and enter each person’s monthly income. Each person pays the same percentage of their income toward rent.
